system.name: MetaphorVU
system.one_liner: A benchmark for metaphorical video understanding plus an inference-time method (MetaphorBoost) that augments cross-domain mapping with a metaphor knowledge graph.

content.variant_note: one example film clip read through three stacked tiers of understanding at the right, a column of platform logos and theme cards at the left
content.argues: Metaphorical videos are everywhere and must be understood beyond object recognition and event description: viewers map visual elements to underlying concepts to reach implicit meanings.
content.subject: Platforms and five video themes at left; one example film clip read through recognition, event description and metaphor understanding at right.

encoding.shape_means: header pill with icon = a tier or a column; chip = one extracted item; wide block arrow = a step to a deeper tier; strip with sprocket holes = a video
encoding.marker_means: no numbers or letters; arrows give the order; ellipses mean more items
encoding.emphasis: the orange tier is highlighted by the italic sentence 'We focus on a deeper level' while the grey tiers above recede

lessons.what_to_learn: Stack the levels of understanding for one concrete example (film strip, then Recognition, Event Description, Metaphor Understanding) as titled tiers joined by wide soft arrows, and tint only the deepest tier in the accent colour with a short italic claim above it.
lessons.suits: Task-introduction figures for benchmarks about higher-level understanding, where the point is how far beyond surface recognition the task goes.

evidence: humans can link visual elements (e.g., tailcoat pigs, banquet, and cats under table) with underlying concepts
metaphorical video understanding requires high-order cognitive capabilities
the core lying in cross-domain mapping that links visual elements to underlying concepts

summary: MetaphorVU introduces MetaphorVU-Bench, a benchmark for understanding metaphorical videos, and MetaphorBoost, an inference-time enhancement that adds a metaphor knowledge graph to improve cross-domain mapping in multimodal LLMs. Figure 1 is a task-introduction figure in two grey rounded panels. At left a grid of eight platform logos opens through a dashed cone into five video-theme cards with play-button thumbnails (Society Criticism, Life Contemplation, Value Advocacy, Relationship Insight, Situation Portrayal). At right one animated clip, shown as a film strip, is read through three stacked tiers joined by wide arrows: Recognition lists objects, Event Description gives three event chips, and the orange Metaphor Understanding tier, flagged 'We focus on a deeper level', maps visual elements to underlying concepts and an implicit meaning.
summary_zh: MetaphorVU 提出隐喻视频理解基准及增强方法。图 1 为任务介绍图：左栏用平台图标和主题视频卡片说明隐喻视频无处不在；右栏用胶片条展示一段示例，经识别、事件描述到橙色的隐喻理解三层，把视觉元素映射到概念和隐含意义。
notes: Prior labels had scope-overview first; the right panel covers more of the area and follows one instance through tiers, so worked-walkthrough is listed first and scope-overview kept for the left column. The five theme names are not called benchmark categories in the supplied text. The film strip is one bitmap holding six frames. The mapping of elements to concepts is read from row alignment and the introduction paragraph.
